blocks.text: 2 A Commission decision (CD) is issued for procedures that affect the terms of the marketing authorisation (e.g. summary of product characteristics, annex II, labelling, package leaflet). The CD is issued within two months of the opinion for variations falling under the scope of Article 23.1a(a) of Regulation (EU) No. 712/2012, or within one year for other procedures.

Outcome: C.2 Change(s) in the summary of product characteristics, labelling or package leaflet of a generic/hybrid/biosimilar medicinal products following assessment of the same change for the reference product - C.2.a) Implementation of change(s) for which no new additional data is required to be submitted by the holder - Accepted C.2.a (Type IB) - To update sections 4.1, 4.2, 5.1, and 5.2 of the SmPC, and sections 1, 2, 3, and 6 of the PL to include treatment of adult patients with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis who have had an inadequate response with, lost response to, or were intolerant to either conventional therapy or a biologic. The change follows approval of the same change for the reference product Stelara. In addition, the

RMP is updated to (1) delete the brand name Qoyvolma, following withdrawal of the duplicate marketing authorisation, (2) include the ulcerative colitis indication, and (3) update the post-authorisation experience. Furthermore, the MAH took the opportunity to implement editorial changes in the PI including (1) formatting updates, (2) correction of typographical errors, and (3) minor changes to the translated PI to align with the reference product and to correct the untranslated text in an icon in the PL for the PFP presentation, ensuring it is aligned with the corresponding icon used for other presentations.
